en.headline: CUHK unveils five-year plan with new postgraduate college
en.dek: The Chinese University of Hong Kong will establish a tenth college dedicated to postgraduate students and reform general education to integrate national education with a global outlook under its 2026–2030 strategy.
body: The Chinese University of Hong Kong on Thursday released its strategic plan for 2026 to 2030, titled “Leaping to Greatness”, the first under president Dennis Lo Yuk-ming.

A key measure is the creation of a new postgraduate college, bringing the total number of colleges to ten and extending the collegiate system’s traditions to graduate students. The university will also reform its mandatory General Education programme to strengthen national education alongside a global perspective, and develop international flagship undergraduate programmes that incorporate innovation, entrepreneurship and sustainability.

Under the TIGER framework covering talent, institutional development, global engagement, education and research, CUHK said it would deepen collaboration with its Shenzhen campus and Greater Bay Area institutions, expand overseas exchanges and internships, and focus research on life and health sciences, artificial intelligence, quantum science and green technology while participating in national scientific programmes.
President Lo said the plan aligns with the national 15th Five-Year Plan and Hong Kong’s first five-year plan, aiming to elevate the university’s academic excellence and global impact.

zh.headline: 中大公布五年策略計劃 將設研究生書院增至10所
zh.dek: 中文大學發布《中大2026-2030》策略計劃，成立第10所書院專供研究生，並革新通識教育融合國民教育與全球視野。
body: 香港中文大學周四公布未來五年策略計劃《中大2026-2030：騰躍新程，勵行志遠》，是校長盧煜明上任後首份五年規劃。
重點措施包括成立研究生書院，令書院總數增至10所，將書院制度延伸至研究生層面；同時革新通識教育，加強國民教育並培養全球視野，以及建構國際化旗艦本科課程，納入創新、創業及可持續發展理念。
計劃以TIGER框架涵蓋人才引進與培育、大學拓展、全球連繫與校友凝聚、教育與學生體驗，以及研究與創新五大範疇。中大表示將加強與深圳校園及大灣區院校合作，拓展海內外交流實習，並聚焦生命健康科技、人工智能、量子科學及綠色科技等前沿領域，積極參與國家科研項目。
盧煜明表示，計劃對接國家「十五五」規劃及香港首個五年規劃，期望提升大學學術卓越及全球影響力。
